task.question: In Ukraine, who was arrested on February 15, 2026, while attempting to flee the country?
task.evidence: 15 February – Former energy minister German Galushchenko is arrested while attempting to flee Ukraine aboard a train amid corruption charges against him.

answer:
On February 15, 2026, the State Bureau of Investigation (SBU) in Ukraine arrested Andrii Ukrainets, the Ukrainian Air Force's Logistics Commander, and Volodymyr Kompanichenko, the head of the SBU for Zhytomyr Oblast, for embezzling funds intended for making hardened aircraft shelters. 

FINAL: Andrii Ukrainets and Volodymyr Kompanichenko.

messages.content:
A suspect was arrested.
A Russian shadow fleet oil tanker Elbus was struck by a drone off the coast of Turkey.
The SBU arrested two GRU agents who were accused of assessing the effectiveness of the Oreshnik missile strike on Lviv.
The State Investigation Bureau (DBR) arrested a Ukrainian military officer in Sumy Oblast on "suspicion of abusing and torturing subordinates" and threatening to shoot soldiers who failed to follow his orders.
The SBU arrested two residents of Izmail on suspicion of registering Starlink satellite internet terminals for Russian forces.
Andrii Ukrainets, the Ukrainian Air Force's Logistics Commander, and Volodymyr Kompanichenko, the head of the SBU for Zhytomyr Oblast, were arrested by the SBU for embezzling some $320,000 intended for making hardened aircraft shelters.
Five vessels of the Russian Black Sea Fleet were damaged including the Russian frigate Admiral Essen, killing three sailors and wounding 14.
The Russian shadow fleet tanker MT Arctic Metagaz caught fire and was reported to have sunk by the Libyan Coast Guard after an alleged drone strike while sailing between Malta and Libya.
Two police officers were injured in a bomb attack in Bucha blamed by the SBU on a suspected "Russian agent", who was arrested.
The SBU said it had arrested a man from a "Balkan country" on suspicion of attempting to assassinate a Ukrainian naval officer on behalf of the FSB with a silenced pistol.
The SBU arrested a woman in Uzhhorod accused of fatally poisoning a Ukrainian serviceman she met on a dating site on behalf of Russia.
The FSB arrested a German woman with an explosive in her backpack in Pyatigorsk.
The SBU said it has arrested a teenage suspect accused of plotting bomb attacks in Kremenchuk on behalf of Russia.
Ukrainian naval drones struck the stern of the shadow fleet tanker MARQUISE; leaving it drifting 210 kilometres (130 mi) from Tuapse.
